samples.question: The image shows four equal panels labeled A, B, C, and D. Each panel contains exactly four identical dark disks. The centers of four disks are concyclic when one circle passes through all four centers. Which labeled panel contains the only concyclic quartet? Ignore labels and locations, inspect every panel, and answer A, B, C, or D. A unique residual gap separates the correct panel from the runner-up.
